title: The Beauty of Fasting and the Example of Samson
english: Because the table was defiled by the mixing with those sacrificing to idols, they ate only seeds. There was also wine poured out for the libation and all meat because of the previously stated reason.

As they were forced by the one presiding to partake in what was being offered to them, lest perhaps their beauty be changed into deformity from self-restraint, and thus that person's reproach and punishment might become the unsightly and unhealed state of the youths; 'Spare us,' they say, 'so that we may not appear less honorable to the King of the revelers, nor shall our faces be rejected, nor will you approach as if presenting to him deformed servants.' For the Artisan of our formation will give grace and will teach through experience, that God is the caretaker of our beauty and fasting is the attendant of the sought-after elegance. And that which has indeed happened. For the youths exceeded all and they all emboldened the meat-eaters.

And what of Samson? Immediately from milk he was not taught to fast in such a way as it was fitting for the child, having been suckled by his mother, to abstain from wine and to guard against all luxury? And who was strong like him? And who was the left-handed one so famously named? He alone was a worthy combatant against every arrangement of wars, and an innumerable multitude he turned back by power; he who, having lacked sword or spear, but ascending upon the jawbone of a donkey, destroyed warlike men by using only the bone.

So then also you were hoping and you shall be strong; with readiness and with power you shall become; give ear to the learning of the hidden things and forget food, just as the people following Jesus, being instructed in word and deed. Let us, the incontinent and the pleasure-loving, Greeks and Jews, not fast in vain and for no end; for they are vainly penalized for what they do not eat, except as a zeal for the matter, which is fitting for the serious.

For Christians, precision in conduct and dignity in philosophy are proper, to whom the pure and true word of piety is present. But those who practice moral discipline apart from this seem to me to be working like those building a house without a foundation or launching a ship without it being steered. Such Hebrews are ill-known. And laughter falls heavily upon me when I behold them, unendurable, wandering around the white mortars with amphorae, a mockery of Moses, a shame to the prophets.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Misunderstanding of Types and the Purpose of Fasting
english: The offspring of Abraham are abortions, slaves of thoughtlessness instead of sons of freedom, ignorant and lawless though supposedly disciples of the law, having lost the hope of the outcome because they did not rationally receive the types of what is to come.

For Moses, in everything he did, prefigured the idols that would come later; whether you speak of the fast, or the feast of tabernacles, or the sounding of the trumpets, likewise the circumcision, the unleavened bread, the bitter herbs. All those things were messages and icons pre-drawn for those being initiated into the mysteries toward the completion.

For I, the Christian, fast well as a slave of the crucified, whether purifying myself toward the hope of the resurrection or clinging as a devoted slave to the sufferings of my Lord. But you, son of the murderers and descendant of those who slaughtered the lamb, having received the inheritance of the shed blood through the voice of the fathers, who thus made vows for themselves and their children, tell me, for what purpose do you fast? If it is as one repenting of the things in which you sinned—I support you in this opinion—and leaving the assembly of those committing adultery, hasten toward the church of the pious. Come to the blood of the lamb and be sprinkled; for from there purification for you shall exist, from which I shall stand away from sin. But if you are still bound to the same things, what do you intend by the abstention from food, or are you imitating the Nile crocodiles, whom they say roar at the heads of the men they ate and weep for the slaughter, not taking repentance for what happened, but rather the fleshless, it seems to me, mourning the head as if it were unfit for eating? Such also is the form regarding the fast.

The fasts are mere dances and plays, middle parts and episodes, things that oppose the outward appearance; for fasting is understood as a pedagogue of thickening and the restraint of elegance, while the dance interprets the spilled [liquid] with unbridled and many pleasantries.

For remember here the Mosaic word saying to fast on the tenth of the seventh month. For the seventh month denotes the seventh day, and the tenth denotes the tenth hour, in which the Lord on the cross gave up [the ghost].
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Typology of Festivals and the Trumpet
english: The Spirit distinguishes each thing, and the forms of sensible appearance reveal the invisible disposition of the soul. Why do you mix the unmixed and carry together those things which are separated? There are other common festivals for them. One they call the Feast of Tabernacles, and another I hear is the remembrance of trumpets. But they celebrate the mysteries of Christians in ignorance, because the creation of the Tabernacle is the practical prophecy of this Church, which our Word established.

For this reason, they also adorn the Tabernacle with leaves and beautify the courts with flowers, as a type of how the new Church is to bring forth fruitfulness by the law. But the feast of the trumpets rouses the souls toward the preparation for the resurrection, as Paul says: 'For the dead shall also be sounded forth and shall arise' (1 Cor 15:52). And God our Savior also teaches in the Gospels, saying: 'And he will send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other' (Matt 24:31).

Hearing these words, they will perhaps use such a contradiction against us: that, remembering the ancient wonders and the blessings of God, they bring these thanksgivings forward in favor of Mount Sinai and the trumpet that sounded at the giving of the law. But the thoughtless will not know that even then the trumpet was taken as a type during the giving of the law.

Since he who receives the law for a rule of life and an orderly polity must demonstrate the punishment for disobedience, therefore God, sending the written commands of our life to men, immediately added also the voice of the trumpet, a symbol of the resurrection from the dead, so that the disciples of the commands, foreseeing the judgment through the resurrection, might guard the doctrines as safeguards of the divine legislation.

Do not fasting and the Feast of Tabernacles and the trumpets of our piety also constitute mysteries of our piety, once indicated in shadow, but reaching their outcome in the proper time, when the theophanies in the flesh of our Savior were completed; to whom belongs the glory and the honor and the worship, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
